objective: Preallocate index scan row id materialization vectors before ordering unordered index hits.

tasks.title: Preallocate index scan row id materialization
tasks.result: Unordered index scan row id materialization now builds the sortable row id vector with explicit capacity from the known row id count.

notes: Cargo/linker verification used an E: workspace temp directory because the default C:/TEMP drive was full.
Ordering, truncation, exact scan behavior, and ordered index row id reuse were kept unchanged.
